title: Lab 3: Start/Stop Seal-In in Ladder
oneLiner: Build the start/stop seal-in rung in CCW's ladder editor and test it on the bench with the same sequence the simulator grader used, including a broken stop wire.
keyTakeaway: The same rung as the simulator: Start and the Motor contact in parallel, in series with a normally open contact for the normally closed Stop button. Unplug the stop wire and the motor can't start: that is fail-safe wiring working.
explanation:
You have built the start/stop seal-in in the simulator. Now you build it in CCW's ladder diagram (LD) editor, download it and test it with real pushbuttons.

The test sequence is the one the simulator grader runs: start, release, stop, release, both together, and a broken stop wire. On the bench you break the wire for real (with the supply off), which shows why stop buttons are wired normally closed: an open circuit looks exactly like a pressed Stop.
